name: ArenaCommand
description: One entry in an ArenaCommandPalette. `hint` is searched but never shown, so a command can be found by a synonym that never appears in its label.

id.description: A stable identity for the command, so a host can switch on it rather than on the label.

label.description: What the command is called, and the primary text searched.

hint.description: Searched but never shown: a synonym that finds the command.

icon.description: A Phosphor class name for the leading glyph Arena draws.

group.description: A heading the command is listed under, such as "Actions" or "Customers". Commands with no group list first and ungrouped, then each group in the order its first command appears, so the caller decides the running order by the order they pass. A flat list is what a caller concatenates four collections into, and the headings are the only thing that says which collection a row came from.

route.description: Where running this command goes. Present, the row renders an <a> and is openable in a new tab, middle-clickable and copyable. A keyboard accelerator over a list of destinations should be all three. ArenaSideNavItem.href carries the same split, for the same reason. The row keeps role="option", because the listbox pattern the palette binds requires that of every row. A screen reader announces the row as an option rather than as a link. The trade is deliberate, since losing the option role would break arrow navigation for every row in the list. A primary click with no modifier and Enter both cancel the anchor and report through `run`. Reporting through `run` is what makes the two agree. Ctrl, meta, shift, alt and a middle click open the destination themselves, emit nothing and leave the palette open. The palette stays open because the reader asked for a second place to look rather than to leave this one.

shortcut.description: The keystroke shown at the row's trailing edge, monospaced. Display only: the palette does not bind it.
